title: Logarithm laws and change of base

sections.heading: Core Concepts: Logarithm laws and change of base

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 4x + 4$ in logarithm laws and change of base, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0$.
A data set recorded for logarithm laws and change of base consists of the four values $\{14, 18, 22, 28\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $14 + 18 + 22 + 28 = 82$, and dividing by $4$ gives $20.5$.
